name: APlatformIndicators
author: Strencher
description: Adds indicators for every platform that the user is using.

changes.title: New Stuff
items: Indicators can now be shown in the favorites list (Beta).
The Status on Avatars can now be replaced by the Platform Indicator (Beta).

changes.title: No more jumping
items: When clicking a DM, the list no longer jumps to the top

changes.title: Harder to break
items: The plugin now finds Discord's components more precisely, so future Discord updates are less likely to make indicators vanish
